experiment: 15N R1, R2 and 1H-15N heteronuclear NOE at 700 MHz
construct_or_mutation: A2 (41-224), the truncation used for crystallography
other_conditions: 0.4mM protein; tumbling: tau_c = 17ns from average R2/R1; used to test oligomeric state; related structures: 2NYT (human A2 41-224 crystal, tetramer), 2RPZ (murine A2 46-224 NMR)
author_claim: R2/R1 gives a rotational correlation time of 17 ns, consistent with a 28 kDa monomer and not a 44 or 88 kDa dimer or tetramer.
anchor: The observed average R 2 /R 1 ratios for A2 (41-224) yielded a rotational correlation time of 17ns, compatible with a 28kDa protein and not a 44 or 88kDa protein
locator: Results, APOBEC2 Solution Dynamics; conditions: Methods, NMR relaxation
caveat_note: Relaxation was used for oligomeric state, not for internal motion; per-residue R1, R2 and NOE are in Supplement Figure S1 (not retrieved). Deposit card gives 310 K and 1 mM; relaxation here is at 25° and 0.4mM. Entry sequence is residues 41-224 of A2.

experiment: 1H-15N HSQC and TALOS+ comparison of full-length A2 and A2 (41-224), assignment spectra at 600 MHz
construct_or_mutation: A2 (1-224), full length; compared with A2 (41-224)
other_conditions: 1mM 2H,13C,15N protein; N-terminal tail = first forty amino acids; regime (authors): flexible, rapidly exchanging region; related structures: 2RPZ, 2NYT
author_claim: The first forty residues give narrow, intense HSQC peaks near 8 ppm and TALOS+ predicts no structure; the tail is highly mobile and does not change the deaminase domain fold.
anchor: Almost all resonances that belong to residues in this region of the protein are very narrow and cluster around 8ppm ( 1 H), suggesting that this stretch of polypeptide is highly mobile.
locator: Results, Truncated and full-length A2 (Figure 2A); conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy (37°C, 600MHz, 1mM)
caveat_note: Full-length construct, not the deposited 41-224 sequence. Temperature 37°C is given for the assignment spectra; the Figure 2A HSQC temperature is not separately stated. Tail residues are named only as 'first forty'.

experiment: CS-HM Rosetta model of full-length A2 from chemical shifts and RDCs (Pf1 and C12E5/hexanol), compared with crystal and NMR structures
other_conditions: alpha1-beta1 loop; related structures: 2RPZ (murine NMR), 2NYT (human crystal, monomers at dimer and tetramer interfaces)
alt_state_structure: 2NYT: alpha1-beta1 loop as a short beta strand in monomers at the dimer interface and as a loop in monomers at the tetramer interface (Figure 5B-D; text, Quaternary State and Model sections)
author_claim: In the full-length model the alpha1-beta1 loop is conformationally highly variable, covering the active site or leaving it exposed, and is disordered in solution; the crystal shows two conformations of this region.
anchor: In the full-length A2 model, this loop is also close to the active-site, but like the N-terminus, this region is conformationally highly variable, and is either covering the active site or leaving it completely exposed.
caveat_note: Inferred from a chemical-shift Rosetta model and crystal comparison, not a direct dynamics measurement; the residue stretch F59-G67 is named for the two crystal conformations and is assumed here to be the alpha1-beta1 loop region. Not the deposited sample.
